title: Improved Elastic Weight Consolidation as an Optimization Constraint for Continual Learning
abstract: arXiv:2611.16039v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Regularization-based continual learning reduces catastrophic forgetting by penalizing changes to parameters that mattered for earlier tasks. Elastic Weight Consolidation (EWC), a standard instance, weights its quadratic penalty by the empirical Fisher, usually justified as approximating loss curvature. We instead derive the penalty from what training on a new task should preserve. In this formulation, Continual Learning as an Optimization Constraint (CLOC), new training must keep chosen functionals of learned behavior unchanged, and the local approximation of this constraint is the stored penalty. We show that EWC's empirical Fisher is exactly the first-order form of this constraint when the preserved functional is each old sample's loss. The derivation exposes a flaw: EWC weights each sample by the scale of its loss gradient, so samples the model fits well barely contribute, although later training can still forget them. Improved EW

translated_title: 改进的弹性权重巩固：作为持续学习的优化约束
translated_abstract: 基于正则化的持续学习通过对改变先前任务中重要参数的行为施加惩罚来缓解灾难性遗忘。弹性权重巩固是其中的标准方法，其二次惩罚项以经验Fisher信息矩阵加权，这一做法通常被解释为对损失曲率的近似。我们则从“在新任务上训练应当保留什么”这一角度出发来推导该惩罚项。在这一表述中——持续学习作为一种优化约束——新任务的训练必须使已学习行为的选定泛函保持不变，而该约束的局部近似即为所存储的惩罚项。我们证明：当被保留的泛函为每个旧样本的损失时，EWC的经验Fisher恰好是该约束的一阶形式。这一推导揭示出一个缺陷：EWC按照每个样本损失梯度的幅值对其进行加权，因此模型已拟合得很好的样本几乎不产生贡献，尽管后续训练仍可能遗忘这些样本。改进的EW（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文将持续学习重新表述为一种优化约束（CLOC），证明EWC的经验Fisher惩罚是该约束的一阶形式，由此揭示EWC对已拟合良好的样本权重过低的缺陷，并提出改进的EWC方法。
en_tdlr: This paper reformulates continual learning as an optimization constraint (CLOC), shows that EWC's empirical Fisher penalty is exactly the first-order form of this constraint, exposes EWC's flaw of underweighting well-fitted samples that can still be forgotten, and proposes an improved EWC method.
